title: Materialize append-only game, team, conference, venue, player, roster, staff, availability, weather, market, and context as-of state
scope: Atomic BAT-396 materialization only. Bulk state payloads remain outside Git; this evidence does not build a feature matrix or claim historical, model, forecast, or scientific readiness.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: State rows retain canonical identity, effective/known-at time, source evidence, and version; corrections append and future observations do not alter prior as-of reads.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: All 313,712 state candidates retain source identity, effective-time, evidence, version, event identity, and supersession fields. 313,015 have a defensible canonical identity; the 697 missing an identity and every row missing known-at remain quarantined. The accepted view is empty. A three-version append-only replay selected v1 at the early cutoff, v2 at the middle cutoff, v3 only at the late cutoff, and appending v3 changed no prior read.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: The work does not fabricate source availability, empirical results, thresholds, model performance, operational readiness, or completion evidence.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: No source-known-at timestamp was substituted; accepted rows remain zero; no cutoff snapshot, matrix, split, model, forecast, metric, BAS, Aggie Excess, or readiness claim was produced. Twelve unsafe manifest mutations were rejected.

No hypothesis, target, feature matrix, split, model, calibrator, prediction, or protected evaluation is created by this state-store unit.
